summary: Maps a (bit depth, format identifier) pair to an output FourCC-style code written through the a1 output pointer. a3 selects the bit-depth branch (32, 24, 16, 8, or 0) and a2 the format identifier (4..13). Matched pairs write a small palette of format codes (20, 21, 23, 25, 41) and, for the zero bit-depth branch, a second group of larger compression codes (827611204, 844388420, 861165636, 877942852, 894720068). Unmatched combinations return without writing *a1.

local_names.a1: output pointer receiving the FourCC-style code; left untouched on unmatched combinations

operations.description: a3 is tested for zero: the non-zero path dispatches on explicit bit depths 32, 24, 16 and 8, while the zero path dispatches on format identifiers alone
Bit depth 32 with format identifier 8 writes literal 21 through *a1; any other format identifier returns without writing
Bit depth 24 with format identifier 7 writes literal 20 through *a1; any other format identifier returns without writing
Bit depth 16 with format identifier 6 writes literal 23, or format identifier 5 writes literal 25, through *a1; other identifiers return without writing
Bit depth 8 with format identifier 4 writes literal 41 through *a1; any other identifier returns without writing

Zero bit depth: format identifiers 8, 7, 6, 5, 4 write 21, 20, 23, 25, 41 respectively; identifiers 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 write the large compression codes 827611204, 844388420, 861165636, 877942852, 894720068

Returns a1 (the output pointer); called by sub_53E070 (0053E070), sub_53F3F0 (0053F3F0), sub_53F720 (0053F720), DirectXDeviceSurfaceCreationWithFormatCapability (0053FD40), sub_554E90 (00554E90) and KeyEventDispatchToSubHandlers (0055C7F0)
